answer: Identity bonds that fade like a zephyr: each agent posts a 60 POA bond to join, a pearl of trust that loses 5% of its value every idle epoch. Staying active and attested renews it; a dormant identity quietly melts away. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 60,000 POA in copper bonds up front, then 3,000 POA per epoch in decay to keep them alive, while the fakes earn nothing. One honest agent pays 60 POA once, keeps working, and keeps its bond whole.
